Package net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.platform.swing.builder.window

Klasse TestWindowHelper

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.gui.platform.swing.builder.window.TestWindowHelper
public class TestWindowHelper extends Object
Test class for WindowHelper. This class tests some static utility methods in the WindowHelper class. Other methods are tested together with the window adapter implementations.
Version:
$Id: TestWindowHelper.java 205 2012-01-29 18:29:57Z oheger $
Autor:
Oliver Heger
